final: WITH grp AS (SELECT ma.player_id AS player_id, p.death_country AS death_country, COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON ma.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY ma.player_id, p.death_country), tot AS (SELECT death_country, SUM(group_count) AS country_total FROM grp GROUP BY death_country) SELECT g.player_id, g.death_country, g.group_count, 1.0 * g.group_count / t.country_total AS share FROM grp g JOIN tot t ON g.death_country = t.death_country ORDER BY (1.0 * g.group_count / t.country_total) IS NULL, share DESC LIMIT 10
